inputs.price: close of the last closed daily candle (Binance NEARUSDT 1d); the spot reference price is recorded but not read
inputs.stake_rate: redemption rate of the staking token in base units, read from the staking contract with the balances

rule: Trend and volatility ensemble on total NEAR (wNEAR plus staked at its redemption rate); idle wNEAR is staked, and a sell unstakes when wNEAR is short.
